description: This file contains the abstract base class 'DocumentObject' used in the MigraDoc library's Document Object Model (DOM). It defines foundational properties and methods shared by all document objects, including cloning, parent/child relationships, serialization, and value management.

classes.name: DocumentObject
classes.description: An abstract base class for all objects within the MigraDoc Document Object Model (DOM), providing common functionality such as cloning, hierarchy management, serialization, and value handling.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DocumentObject instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the actual deep copying of the object, resetting parent and owner references.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a value object based on its name using metadata.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given name, respecting access flags.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a given name and updates parent references if necessary.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks whether a value with the specified name exists.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks whether the value associated with a given name is null.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Resets the value corresponding to a name to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Determines whether this object instance is null or unset.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Resets this object instance to null or unset state.
